verdict.rationale: Dots is a ChatGPT-hosted AI agent, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack never mentions any control over whether conversations are used for model training. The documented controls cover app permissions, action rules, pausing, memory notes and optional password saving, which are adjacent features and do not address training use.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can control whether my conversations are used to train models
